name: Listen
tooltip: Switches between your mix and the reference at matched loudness
notes: 5 ms equal-power crossfade at the next block

name: Reference
tooltip: Which of the loaded references plays

name: Match
tooltip: How both sides reach the same loudness; Off keeps raw levels

name: Blind
tooltip: Hides which side is which and keeps a tally of your votes

name: Trim
tooltip: Monitoring level for both sides; never touches a bounce

name: Mono
tooltip: Sums both sides to mono at -3 dB

name: Follow transport
tooltip: Plays the reference section in step with the song position

name: Trim mix instead
tooltip: Trims your mix to the match target too

name: Section
tooltip: Which part of the reference plays and loops
notes: Markers are plugin state per reference

name: Match target
tooltip: Loudness both sides meet at when Trim mix instead is on
